# Changelog

All notable changes to Fixate will be documented in this file.

## [0.1.0] — Unreleased

### Added
- RSVP reading mode with configurable WPM (100-1000)
- Bionic Reading mode (optional)
- Sentence reading mode
- Parafoveal preview (next-word ghost in RSVP)
- Focus line and paragraph focus overlays
- Working memory sidebar (last 5 paragraphs)
- Reading ruler (accent-colored guide line)
- 15 accessibility themes (WCAG AA compliant)
- 6 fonts including OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible
- Central font registry (`config/fonts.py`)
- White/pink/brown noise generation (Web Audio API)
- Noise customization (EQ, LFO, presets)
- Noise sample preview and scheduler fade
- Hyperfocus engine with DMN disruption
- ADHD profile system with per-type adaptation
- Pre-reading ritual with breath pacing
- Breathing breaks (box breathing, 4-7-8)
- Bilateral stimulation (4 presets)
- Figure-paragraph linking with sticky figure panel
- EPUB support via ebooklib
- Cloud OCR via AWS Textract
- Desktop OCR via Tesseract
- Sound cue engine (24 categories, anti-habituation)
- TTS Read Aloud engine (system voices)
- Attention Hack Engine (5 transition modes)
- XP/Level gamification (Fibonacci thresholds)
- Streak heatmap (180-day grid)
- Daily quote + greeting + streak bar
- Scenic video backgrounds (8 presets + custom URLs)
- CSS gradient backgrounds (5 scenes)
- Kanban task board with drag-and-drop
- Sticky notes with masonry layout
- Spotify playlist embed
- Real-time co-working rooms (WebSocket)
- Flashcard system (SM-2 spacing, flip animation)
- Highlight journal with markdown export
- Brain Map Board (infinite canvas)
- Auto-Outline generator
- Document organization (folders, search, tags)
- Tauri desktop shell (.deb, .AppImage, .msi/.exe)
- Stripe Pro page (coming soon placeholder)
